summary: The requested feature uses a distinct valid retro treatment confined to the selected-square strip, with behavior and focus preserved. Design basis: AD-3 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Component tokens and placement. Planned browser helper (not present yet) and node:test checks are not yet run; browser command: `node scripts/check-selected-square-summary-browser.mjs --viewports 390x844,1440x1000 --keyboard-focus --out "$(mktemp -d)/observation"`.

criteria.text: The selected-square summary strip alone uses the explicit pixel-arcade direction in AD-3 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Strip treatment and boundary and Component tokens and placement. On a narrow phone and wide desktop rendered browser view, retain its below-board position, readable coordinate and the unchanged board and controls. Use the selected panel #1d1820, accent #f5c451, 3px frame and 0.8rem spacing as reproducible anchors. This browser check is planned, not yet run. Serves R-2.

A selected square appears as its coordinate in the summary strip; Reset returns it to Choose a square while preserving the 64 local square controls and current status behavior. Planned regression command, not yet run: node --test test/board-state.test.mjs; require TC-BOARD to pass. Serves R-1.

Keep keyboard focus visibly distinct on the square controls and Reset while the summary strip stays readable and does not obscure them. Check keyboard navigation in a rendered browser at 390x844 and 1440x1000; this focus check is planned, not yet run.

steps.task: Implement the strip’s scoped retro treatment and initial empty state (C1), keep keyboard focus visible (C3), and create the planned browser observation helper.
Add and test the summary's selected-coordinate and Reset state (C2).

expectations.statement: The existing architecture record has no accepted AD for the requested strip direction yet.
The baseline page has no selected-square summary strip markup.
